encode_text_with_word_tokenizer: create a WordTokenizer from a CSV vocab file and encode a text string into token IDs
decode_tokens_with_word_tokenizer: create a WordTokenizer and decode a sequence of token IDs back into a text string
encode_graph_node: create a GraphTokenizer and encode a graph node string into an array of token IDs
split_graph_node: use the GraphTokenizer split_node classmethod to tokenize a quoted node string into word tokens
split_graph_edge: use the GraphTokenizer split_edge classmethod to tokenize an edge string into a list of tokens
